account.label: Audience ID
account.help: The Mailchimp Audience (List) ID the reminder campaigns are sent to, found under Audience > Settings > Audience name and defaults.

credentials.name: MAILCHIMP_API_KEY
credentials.label: API key
credentials.help: Profile > Extras > API keys, in the Mailchimp account that owns the audience. Carries its data center as the suffix after the last '-' (e.g. ...-us6).

endpoint.label: API base URL (self-hosted test double only)
endpoint.help: Leave empty to use the account's own Mailchimp data center. Only a stand-in for the tool on the loopback, for testing, sets this.

config.name: from_name
config.label: From name
config.help: Shown to recipients as who the reminder is from.

config.name: reply_to
config.label: Reply-to address
config.help: Where a recipient's reply to a reminder goes.
